entities.name: Eugénie Cotton
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugénie Cotton was a French scientist, socialist, women's rights advocate and was active in the resistance. She was awarded the Stalin Peace Prize in 1951, Knight of the Legion of Honor, and the Gold medal from the World Peace Council in 1961. She died aged 85 in Sèvres, near Paris.
